backend_validation_note.clone_settings: Source foreach/fused/capturable/differentiable settings retained per parameter group.
backend_validation_note.synthetic_backend: CPU unfused; float32 and float64, multi-group, AMSGrad, weight decay, memory keep/clear, None gradient
backend_validation_note.real_backend_validation: Each real assay validates keep/clear on cloned full body parameters using the actual saved backend; results stored in real_adam_checks and checks.

gauge_validation_note.float32: Same relative tolerance 2e-5, applied to each parameter and all trunk parameters jointly; zero absolute floor, exactly zero reference requires zero alternative. Cosine tolerance derived as 2*rtol^2.
gauge_validation_note.float64: Strict synthetic identity: relative L2 and max-absolute 1e-11; precision of cosine reduction handled separately.
gauge_validation_note.malformed_inputs: Reject 1e-3 scale and directional perturbations, nonzero vector against zero reference, NaN, and float64 1e-6 error; accept float32 near-zero component perturbation with total relative error 1e-6.
